text:
alex_globex: Hey team — invoice INV-2026-0456 arrived but the PO number is missing. AP flagged it and they won't post without PO-998877. Invoice is already paid. Can you add the PO to the invoice or advise on reissue vs credit+rebill?

sara: Sorry about that, Alex. Can you confirm the correct PO (got PO-998877) and whether the payment was via card or bank transfer? That affects whether we can reissue after payment.

alex_globex: Confirmed PO-998877. Payment was by corporate card (txn tx_9a8b7c). Prefer a corrected/reissued invoice if possible so AP doesn't have to open a new payment.

raj: Looping in finance — @marie can we reissue a corrected invoice once a card payment is settled? Any VAT/regulatory caveats?

marie: We can reissue in most card cases by creating a superseding invoice and marking the prior invoice as "superseded" in our ledger. If the customer needs the original invoice number preserved for audit, we can't change that, but we can issue a corrected invoice that references the original. VAT should stay the same unless the line items or tax jurisdiction change. Need the original txn id and a quick AP contact so we can coordinate payment reallocation.

sara: OK — proposed ops checklist for this thread:
1) Verify payment settled (invoicer-bot confirmed below).
2) Create corrected invoice with PO-998877 and mark it as replacement/superseded for INV-2026-0456.
3) If invoice cannot be reissued per accounting rules, create credit memo for INV-2026-0456 and generate new invoice with PO.
4) Payments team to reapply the card transaction to the new invoice / record journal entries.
5) Notify customer and provide new invoice PDF and accounting reference.

sara: Quick internal repro / commands for billing ops to find the invoice:
```
# fetch invoice
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILL_API_KEY" "https://billing.redwood.example.com/api/v1/invoices/INV-2026-0456" | jq .

# create corrected invoice (ops only)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILL_API_KEY" -d '{"replace_invoice":"INV-2026-0456","po_number":"PO-998877","note":"Reissued to include PO"}' https://billing.redwood.example.com/api/v1/invoices
```

invoicer-bot: Payment for INV-2026-0456 confirmed at 2026-03-16T14:22:09Z (txn: tx_9a8b7c) :white_check_mark:

raj: If we end up doing credit+rebill instead of reissue, note that the credit memo will create a temporary outstanding balance until the rebill is paid or the payment is reapplied — finance needs a go-ahead from the customer to proceed. Also tagging tax: VAT might need a separate note on the new invoice.

alex_globex: We're fine with credit+rebill if that's the only way to keep the payment applied, but we'd still prefer a reissue. Please confirm which route you take and send the audit refs.

marie: Understood. I'll start creating the corrected invoice first; if accounting flags an issue we'll swap to credit+rebill and I'll post the credit memo number. ETA: within 24 hours.

sara: I've created internal ticket BILL-4721 and assigned to billing-ops. Tracker: https://redwood.example.com/billing/BILL-4721 — will update here when done.

alex_globex: Thanks all — appreciate the quick help :pray:

sara: Leaving follow-ups here: @marie please paste the corrected invoice ID or credit memo when ready. I'll cc AP contact: ap@globex.example.com once we have final docs.
